Data coverage & ranking

Candidate pools come from GeckoTerminal’s public new-pool feeds for Solana and Base. The same token may have several pools; we retain the most liquid returned pool. Retained contracts are refreshed in batches for current liquidity and five-minute flow. Pool creation is not necessarily token launch time.

Use Investigate for a coin that is no longer in the fresh-pool return. It searches by name, ticker, or contract and hands the exact contract to Order Flow.

New candidates must have a pool created within 36 hours, at least $3,000 liquidity, and at least five recent transactions. Once discovered, they remain for five days. The filters use time since first discovery; the default is one hour. Choose Newest, 5m volume, 5m activity, or Liquidity explicitly.

Only exact-contract evidence earns the Exact contract label. RSS, name/ticker matches, and general public-web results remain unverified leads. A dash in a 5m field means data is unavailable, not zero. This is not a safety assessment or a trading signal.
